# Supervisor Coach: Synthetic pump fire, 2024

**DRAFT**

Review: draft · Classification: internal · Version 1.0

Draft because: no finding is marked as edited by a person

*Learning purposes: not a statutory document · Learnings drafted by an AI agent from AI-assisted findings*

**Audience:** T2 first-line supervision

**Incident:** Synthetic pump fire · 2024-03-20

## Bottom line

- Do not accept a disturbed joint back into service without its leak-test record. [FND-0001; FND-0002]

## Before work starts

- [ ] Confirm the replacement seal matches the specification on the work order. [FND-0003]

## Before equipment returns to service

- [ ] **Hold point:** Leak-test record attached and signed. *(before return to service)* [FND-0001; EVD-0001] *(learning: LR-01)*

## Known problems

A repeat seal leak on the same pump is a signal to escalate to the maintenance manager, not a routine repair [FND-0002].

## In an emergency

**Q: May a shift supervisor isolate the pump without waiting for approval?**
- Why it matters: The gas alarm only displayed and nobody was authorised to act [FND-0004].
- Put to: Site leadership

*(learning: LR-02)*

## What to refuse

- [ ] Refuse to accept a pump whose seal has no specification reference. [FND-0003]

Some regimes give workers and supervisors a right to stop work or to warn of imminent danger. The site should confirm which apply here, and how a supervisor who declines to accept work is supported [FND-0002].

## Recommendations and how supervisors will know they are working

**Recommendation:** Interlock pump start on a signed leak-test record [FND-0001; FND-0002]
- Control tier: engineering
- Barrier: Return-to-service test
- Owner: Maintenance supervisor
- Leading indicator: % of pump restarts with a leak-test record on the shift log

## Coaching conversations

**Scenario:** A fitter says the seal is the same as last time and asks to skip the test. [FND-0001]

1. What would you ask for?
2. Who would you call?

## Brief your crew

| Order | Card | Bring back | Where the check should live | Cites |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Test what you disturb | Any job where the test rig was not available | Return-to-service certificate | FND-0001; FND-0002 |
| 2 | Know what the gas alarm does | Alarms the crew could not say the response to | Shift log | FND-0004 |
